text: Stakeholder/RACI owner and approver are named. Scope includes in scope and out of scope. Assumption and constraint are listed. Change Request and change control are defined. UAT acceptance sign-off maps to RTM traceability from BRQ to FR to US to TC. Handover includes KT and warranty.
The project has scope and stakeholders. The team will implement features and discuss changes later.

Problem and persona are defined with user pain point. MVP scope and release roadmap are listed. Backlog contains user story and acceptance criteria with prioritization. Success metric KPI and analytics event tracking funnel are defined. Hypothesis experiment and risk assumptions are listed.

Regulatory compliance includes KYC AML. Payment transaction settlement and reconciliation are specified. Security authentication authorization and fraud controls are included. Audit log evidence is retained. NFR availability latency SLA performance are defined. Exception rollback timeout retry handling is documented. UAT traceability RTM acceptance is required.

Clinical workflow of bác sĩ and điều dưỡng is mapped. PHI and PII follow consent and privacy rules. HL7 FHIR messages exchange data with the HIS. Audit log and access control cover every record; encryption is required. Clinical validation and patient safety review are scheduled. UAT acceptance traceability links each requirement to a test.
The system shows appointments for the clinician and lets staff print reports. The team will test it before release.

Procurement follows the bidding rules in the hồ sơ mời thầu. Regulatory compliance cites the applicable nghị định. Multi-level acceptance by the hội đồng nghiệm thu is defined. Security classification sets the cấp độ an toàn thông tin. Approval chain and sign-off are documented. Traceability RTM maps BRQ to FR. Retention and archive rules apply to audit records.
The portal lets citizens submit applications and officers review them. Reports are exported monthly.

Problem and pain point of freelancers are described. Hypothesis and assumption are listed. MVP in scope and out of scope are fixed. KPI metric: week-4 retention. Budget and timeline are two months. Backlog has user story with acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder map lists each department owner with RACI. As-is and to-be process are drawn. Training and change management support adoption. Operational readiness covers go-live, support and rollback. Governance sets who gives approval for each change request. UAT acceptance closes the project.
The descriptions of the kitchen items were discussed over coffee with the crew.
Users pay by card and the security team checks the login page.
